_note: Lay-term glossary used by the patient-friendly rewrite. Original wording.

terms.pneumothorax: air leak around the lung (partly collapsed lung)
terms.atelectasis: a partly deflated area of lung
terms.consolidation: an area of lung filled with fluid or infection
terms.infiltration: a hazy area in the lung
terms.infiltrate: a hazy area in the lung
terms.opacity: a whiter area on the X-ray
terms.cardiomediastinal silhouette: the outline of the heart and central chest
terms.hiatus hernia: part of the stomach sitting up in the chest
terms.hernia: part of an organ pushing through a muscle wall
terms.glioma: a growth from the brain's supporting cells
terms.meningioma: a growth on the brain's lining (usually slow-growing)
terms.pituitary tumour: a growth on the hormone gland at the base of the brain
terms.pituitary tumor: a growth on the hormone gland at the base of the brain
terms.clinical correlation: your doctor comparing this with your symptoms and examination
terms.correlate clinically: your doctor will compare this with your symptoms
terms.no acute cardiopulmonary abnormality: nothing urgent seen in the heart or lungs
